property_summary: For any caller address x and newOwner address y, only a current owner can successfully call transferOwnership — after calling transferOwnership as msg.sender x, C.owner() == x if and only if the call succeeded; the mutant inverts the owner check allowing non-owners to change owner, so there exist x,y where a non-owner call changes owner.
change_summary: Invert the require condition so only non-owners can pass the modifier, allowing non-owners to call transferOwnership and change owner.
